thread:
Mei: Rainy night challenge: recommend one film or TV episode + one song that pairs with it. Not a playlist—one tight pairing. I'll go first.
Carlos: Love it. Film: "Before Sunrise" + Song: Nick Drake - "River Man". Quiet, conversational, slightly damp. :umbrella:
Priya: TV ep: "Charlie Brooker's Black Mirror" - "San Junipero" + Song: The Postal Service - "Such Great Heights". Bittersweet nostalgia.
Jonah: Movie: "The Rider" (slow burn) + Song: Sufjan Stevens - "Casimir Pulaski Day". Melancholy and real.
Kelsey: Throwback: Movie: "Amelie" + Song: Yann Tiersen - "Comptine d'un autre été". Cozy and whimsical. :croissant:
Mei: Nice picks. Bonus rule: if you recommend a song with lyrics, include one line you'd read aloud in the margins of a rainy-night zine.
Carlos: Line for mine: "We felt the rain like applause." (not real lyrics, but mood)
Priya: For mine: "We move forward with the awkward kindness of strangers." (again mood quote)
Jonah: For mine: "There are small things that fix the sky."
Kelsey: For mine: "She rearranged the streetlights into a better map."
Mei: @MusicBot can you spin up a shared doc capturing pairings? I want to save these.
MusicBot: Created document "rainy-night-pairings" and posted link: https://redwood.example/doc/rainy-night-pairings :robot_face:
Carlos: Also vote: physical zine or ephemeral doc? React with :book: for zine, :memo: for doc. (a flurry of reactions)
Priya: Zine gets my vote. I will volunteer to lay out a page.
Jonah: I will print 5 copies and hide them in the office kitchenette for conspiracy vibes.
Kelsey: If we make a zine, can we include a tiny pocket with a matchbox for candlelight? Practical, not arson. :candle:
Mei: Agreed. This went from hypothetical to artisanal very quickly. Love the energy.
Carlos: If anyone wants to add a pairing later, drop it in the doc and tag me for zine edits.
MusicBot: Reminder set: "Monthly rainy-night pairing roundup" scheduled on the first Tuesday of each month.
Mei: Thanks team. Night-appropriate signing off. :night_with_stars:
